ideaInboxDescription: Keep ideas here to organize or archive later. They will not become Canon.
completedItemsDoNotPassFinalCheck: Completing an item does not mean it has passed Final Check and will not automatically change the manuscript.
pinnedReferenceWriterNotice: Pinned · Read-only reference · Not automatically sent to Writer
editDocumentInMainPane: Edit this document in the main pane
confirmedStyleReferenceWriterNotice: Author-confirmed style reference · Not automatically sent to Writer
currentKnowledgeHistoryHint: Current knowledge (use the Knowledge Center if chapter history is available)
resumeLastActualScopeThread: Resume the last actual thread for this Scope
taskOutputEmptyHint: Live output will appear here after you start a task.
unsavedChangesNavigationNotice: The current content has not been saved. Discarding your changes will open the target page or reload the file.
executionSequenceIntro: The following steps will run in order:
reviewSequenceLabels: Canon / Continuity / Characters / Scenes / Language review
stateCommitExcludedNotice: State Commit is outside this workflow and is disabled by default.
proposedStateCommitVerificationNotice: The specified Proposed is about to be committed to official State. The server will recheck Final, the baseline, the semantic diff review, and the Validation receipt.
readOnlyTextAnnotationHint: The text is read-only; select text to add an annotation.
annotationLocationNeedsConfirmation: The annotation location needs to be confirmed again
chapterSearchScopeNotice: Searches chapter text only. A textual mention does not establish actual presence; Final, Draft, and separate revision versions are labeled individually.
convertToChapterTask: Convert to a task for this chapter
planFieldsAreNotFacts: Plan fields do not represent events that have already occurred
revisionCandidateApprovalHelp: The author decides which candidates to keep. Accepting changes to the official manuscript creates a separate revision; it does not commit State.
authorConfirmAndSaveRevision: Author confirmation / Save as a revised version
cancelPreviewBeforeProceeding: Cancel the preview first; the original upload will remain in the target work's materials.
novelImportHelp: Select a target, then upload for preview. You can adjust chapter breaks manually. Only drafts or separate revisions are added; Final is never overwritten. A backup is created automatically before import.
shortStoryWithoutChapterSplits: Do not split a short story into chapters (the target must be a short story or free-form text)
chapterImportAppendHelpSuffix: plans/manuscripts; imported chapters will be appended after the highest existing chapter number. Existing manuscripts will not be overwritten.
replacementPreviewHelp: Confirm each plain-text replacement individually. For committed Final manuscripts, only separate revisions are created. YAML and entity IDs are not replaced. Preview up to 10 matches per file.
confirmSelectedMatchesAndSaveRevision: Confirm selected matches and save revision
workSnapshotHelp: Uses Data Center's verified backup system. Restore snapshots in Data Center; the pre-restore version is retained. A snapshot is not a State Commit.
createCurrentWorkSnapshot: Create a snapshot of the current work
draftSaveRequestedReselect: Saving the current draft has been requested. Select the text again before running to ensure the selection is tied to the saved version.
selectionInvalidReselect: The selection is no longer valid. Please select the text again.
sourceChangedCannotOverwrite: The original text or editor has changed and cannot be overwritten. Close the candidate, save, and compare again.
novelDefaultAndSecondaryStyles: Novel default and enabled secondary writing styles
selectionComparisonHelp: Left: original. Right: candidate (editable). Changes apply only to the original selection; accepted changes to a finalized manuscript are saved as a separate revision.
acceptedChangesRequireStateChecks: After accepting text changes, recheck facts and State. No memory is committed automatically.
chineseVoiceUnavailable: No Chinese voice is installed on this system. Read-aloud is unavailable.
externalChangeRetained: The file changed externally. Your edits were retained. View the latest version, then confirm reloading and merge your changes.
codexFinishedRetainedEdits: The Codex task ended. Your unsaved edits are retained if the file changed. Use Reload to view the latest version and merge.
eventConnectionInterrupted: The live event connection was interrupted. Open task history to reconnect.
proposalCommittedNoState: The proposal was accepted and saved. Dynamic State was not committed.
manualStateCommitRequired: State Commit always requires manual confirmation
chapterWorkbenchDescription: Plan, prose, review and proposed State changes are organized around one chapter.
chapterWorkflowExplanation: The chapter workflow includes Context → Draft → Review → Revise → Final → Memory. State Commit requires separate confirmation.
chooseChapterGateExplanation: Choose an existing chapter or enter its number to inspect the required files and permissions.
compactWorldUnknownNotice: Compact world settings. Undefined areas may remain UNKNOWN / TBD.
volumePlanningNotice: Volume concepts and detailed outlines are separate. Prose does not start automatically.
codexWorkspaceSdkNotice: Tasks run in a fixed workspace through the official Python SDK connected to local Codex.
localTextEditingNotice: Edit local Markdown / YAML / JSON. Check external changes before saving.
emptyProjectThreadHelp: Leave blank for a project-level thread
readStateInstructionExample: Read the current State and explain the steps needed for this chapter…
revisionScopeChanged: The project or chapter changed. This revision operation was stopped.
restoreSettingInSourcePage: Restore non-manuscript versions through the confirmation flow on their original settings page.
revisionLocalHelp: Edit the candidate on the right. Only “Confirm and save revision” adopts it. Closing the preview preserves the original candidate; rejecting it is a separate action.
chooseRevisionPreview: Choose a saved version or AI candidate to compare. Previewing does not change the manuscript.
unsavedRevisionHelp: You edited the candidate or revision note without accepting it. Continue editing to keep these changes. Discarding preserves the stored original candidate and does not change the manuscript.
discardAndRejectRevision: Discard local edits and reject suggestion
discardAndCloseRevision: Discard local edits and close preview
